page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.24xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-CPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The lack of integrated local storage and GPUs represents a design tradeoff, focusing resources entirely on high-density CPU compute capacity and network throughput.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c8a.24xlarge offers a high density of dedicated AMD EPYC cores relative to its memory footprint, making it a resource-efficient option for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory allocations or local NVMe drives. Suitable workloads include high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and compute-heavy CI/CD pipelines.
